title: NeBULA2025: Standardized reaching motor-execution EEG dataset (NeBULA)
description: NeBULA2025 is a BIDS-formatted release of a high-density EEG and surface EMG dataset recorded from 39 healthy adults performing a standardized right-arm reaching task toward one of three illuminated targets. The task was performed under three robotic assistance levels (free, low, high). The dataset supports neuromechanical biomarker research for upper limb assessment.
methods_description: 128-channel Brain Products actiCHamp EEG (127 EEG channels, 1000 Hz, reference FCz, ground Fpz) was recorded together with 11 EMG channels. Seated participants reached toward a target when its light turned on, at a normal pace, then returned the hand to the right leg. Each participant completed 3 runs of about 10 trials per movement type, one run per assistance level.

funding_references.funder_name: Istituto Nazionale Assicurazione Infortuni sul Lavoro (INAIL)
